about.heading: About Us
about.body: First Baptist Church of Rising Sun is a welcoming place for everyone. We gather to worship, grow in faith, and serve our community together. Whether you've been walking with God for decades or are just beginning to explore, there's a place for you here.

vbs.description: A week of games, crafts, music, and Bible stories for kids in our community. It's free, it's a blast, and all are welcome — bring a friend!
